about: Can a public USB charger steal your data (juice jacking). Factory #36, backlog row 41, slug juicejacking. One hard idea: the FBI (Denver field office, one X post, April 6, 2023) warned about juice jacking but the post names no case (researchers have shown it in labs, ChoiceJacking, USENIX Security 2025; FCC page disabled by its owner 2026-11-19, so the FCC is not cited); phones ask before data moves (iPhone 'Trust This Computer?', Android's File Transfer choice), so at a public port never tap Trust or Allow, or use your own wall plug. Sources read 2026-11-19, see BRIEF.md.
